source_scope: Public MT6739 Wiko reference; not exact Huawei proof

observations.userspace_control: Character driver maps MMIO and allocated noncache memory; lock/unlock/waitISR/power/accounting interfaces. No complete frame-level V4L2 bitstream decoder in these7 reference files.
observations.hal_stub: hal.c eHalCmdProc SET_CMD_QUEUE/SET_POWER/SET_ISR cases do nothing and return success; not decoding implementation
observations.clock_order: Decoder MT_SCP_SYS_VDE then MT_CG_VDEC; encoder MT_SCP_SYS_VEN then MT_CG_VENC; reference only
observations.codec_enums: HEVC_DEC and H264_DEC share lock/unlock/waitISR paths. HEVC_ENC references are generic enum branches, not proof of MT6739 HEVC encoder hardware support.
observations.mmap_caution: Legacy checks start and length separately; do not port unchecked. Native mapping must validate complete range, ownership and lifetime.
observations.native_requirement: Need frame-level bitstream/parser/register programming or verified compatible open native backend; porting lock ioctl alone cannot decode video.
